rules.name: Protected swing is the structure expected to hold if trend continues
rules.setupAnchor: Recent swing high or low interacting with a sweep or fair value gap
rules.confirmationTrigger: Closure through the opposing candle series after the interaction
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Bullish protected low or bearish protected high formed after sweep/FVG interaction and confirming close
rules.invalidationCondition: Protected swing high or low is violated
rules.targetLogic: Use the protected swing to define directional continuation and invalidation
exceptions: A sweep without the confirming close is not a protected swing
machineChecks: Detect liquidity sweep beyond local swing
Detect confirming close beyond reference candle series
ambiguityNotes: Candle series segmentation needs a strict implementation rule

rules.name: Protected swings provide structural stop placement
rules.confirmationTrigger: Entry is taken in the direction of the confirmed protected swing
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Stop reference is the protected swing itself by default
rules.invalidationCondition: Price trades through the protected swing
rules.targetLogic: Hold until higher timeframe objective or next phase transition
exceptions: Candle body stop can be used to improve RR with higher stop-out risk
If RR is poor, wait for continuation protected swing instead of forcing entry
machineChecks: Default stop equals protected swing extreme
Optional aggressive stop equals candle body reference
Allow trailing stop updates from newer protected swings
ambiguityNotes: Body-based stop logic should probably be optional and clearly flagged as aggressive

rules.name: Trade direction should follow the most recent valid protected swing logic
rules.setupAnchor: Most recent valid protected high or low
rules.confirmationTrigger: Continuation entry forms in same direction as the structure
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: New protected swings can stack and become stepping stones
rules.invalidationCondition: Opposite-direction protected swing confirms a structure shift
rules.targetLogic: Use the active structure until invalidated or higher timeframe objective is reached
exceptions: Lower timeframe protected swings should not override higher timeframe bias without broader confirmation
machineChecks: Maintain most recent protected swing by direction and timeframe
Reject entries that oppose active higher timeframe structure
ambiguityNotes: Need explicit precedence rules when timeframes disagree

rules.name: Anticipation is allowed, but confirmation requires the correct closing event
rules.setupAnchor: Potential protected swing forms at a fair value gap or sweep location
rules.confirmationTrigger: Price closes through the correct candle series on the originating timeframe
rules.protectedSwingDefinition: Before that close, the swing is only anticipated and not structurally confirmed
rules.invalidationCondition: Lower timeframe entry taken before higher timeframe confirmation is riskier because the broader shift is not yet validated
rules.targetLogic: Use anticipation only for closer invalidation and better RR, not as a replacement for confirmation
exceptions: Lower timeframe CISD can be used before higher timeframe confirmation, but only as an aggressive entry model
machineChecks: Represent anticipated and confirmed protected swings as distinct states
Require originating timeframe close for confirmation
Flag pre-confirmation entries as aggressive mode
ambiguityNotes: Need a strict definition of the correct candle series before confirmation can be fully codified
